title.zh: v2.11.2 CI 修正：手动开关的 jank/skins 档先构建再跑探针；push 时的 E2E 从「只跑桌面」改成全量 7 个目标
title.en: v2.11.2 CI Fixes: the Manual Switch Builds Before Its Probes, and the Push-Time E2E Runs All Seven Targets Instead of Desktop Only

highlights.zh: **手动开关的 `jank` 档跑不起来**——`probe:jank`（和 `probe:skins`）自己起静态服务托管 `dist/`，而工作流只为 `e2e` 档构建，所以手工触发 `jank` 直接失败：`❌ dist/index.html is missing — build first`。现在加了一个显式的 Build 步骤（覆盖 `jank`/`skins`/`all`），并把它放在两个探针之前；`verify` 档自己会构建、`audio` 不需要，都在注释里写明。已在本机复现同一个报错，并用修正后的顺序（build → probe:jank）跑通。
highlights.en: **The manual switch's `jank` scope could not run.** `probe:jank` (and `probe:skins`) serve `dist/` themselves, but the workflow only built for the `e2e` scope, so a manual `jank` run failed outright: `❌ dist/index.html is missing — build first`. There is an explicit Build step now (covering `jank`/`skins`/`all`) placed before both probes; `verify` builds on its own and `audio` needs nothing, and the comments say so. The failure was reproduced locally and the corrected order…

highlights.zh: **CI 的 E2E 门禁从「只跑桌面」改成**每次 push / PR 跑 `npm run test:e2e:all`（**7/7**：3 个桌面浏览器 + iPhone 竖/横 + iPad 竖/横）。当初缩减成桌面档的理由是「手机界面正在重做、断言会被重做作废」——这个理由早已不存在，而**跳过三分之二目标的门禁，正是 iPad 专属回归能活到线上的原因**（上一轮那次 iPad 横屏失败就是例证，虽然那次是环境挂起）。`test:e2e`（`E2E_PROFILE=pc`）保留为本机快速迭代用，但**CI 不再调用它**，并且新增测试断言这一点：CI 的 e2e 任务必须调用 `test:e2e:all`、必须不匹配 `npm run test:e2e`、必须在矩阵之前构建。文档（`ARCHITECTURE_SURFACES.md` §6 与矩阵自身的注释）同步更新，不再声称这是「有意的门禁缩减」。
highlights.en: **The CI E2E gate now runs `npm run test:e2e:all` — all seven targets** (three desktop browsers, iPhone portrait/landscape, iPad portrait/landscape) on every push and pull request. The reduction to the desktop profile existed because the phone UI was mid-redesign and its assertions would have been invalidated by it; that reason expired, and **a gate that skips two thirds of the targets is how an iPad-only regression reaches production** (the iPad-landscape failure last round…

highlights.zh: **全量皮肤扫描改成「只报告」**，因为它第一次跑就暴露出一批**工作项**而不是回归：像素皮肤在**对比视图上有 227 个低对比元素**、底鼓 102、银河 105、分析器 97、时间轴 20——这些视图此前从未被抽样审计过。手工 CI 的 `skins` 档现在跑 `--report`（打印每套皮肤 × 每个视图的表格，不失败），而 `verify` 里那个抽样扫描仍是门禁，棘轮只降不升。这批数字已经进入下一轮的工作清单（像素皮肤的非工作室视图是重点）。
highlights.en: **The full skin sweep is report-only now**, because its first run produced **work items rather than regressions**: the pixel skin has **227 low-contrast elements on the compare view**, 102 on the kick lab, 105 on the galaxy, 97 on the analyser and 20 on the timeline — views that had never been sampled by the audit before.
